verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents several built-in ways to act on many items at once. Bulk edit adds or modifies multiple request parameters in one step, collection-level headers and auth apply to every request in that collection, and collections and environments can be imported together. These are narrow, feature-specific forms of bulk action rather than a general multi-select tool across items. Missing for 10: documented bulk select/delete/move/update across many requests or collections, bulk operations exposed for agents via the MCP server or CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Hoppscotch also offers a Bulk edit feature, allowing you to add or modify multiple request parameters at once
When you add a header or auth to a collection, it will be applied to all requests in that collection.
Support simultaneous imports of collections and environments.
